verdict.rationale: Zulip's integrations page lists an "Incoming webhooks" category alongside 130+ native integrations, so first-party incoming-webhook support exists. However, the pack gives no detail on generating a webhook URL, how messages map to channels or topics, or payload format. The "Send a message" REST API is a separate authenticated API and does not show a simple webhook URL. missing for 10: documentation of generating a per-channel incoming webhook URL, payload/format details for posting a message, channel/topic targeting, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can post a message into a channel with a simple incoming webhook URL
